content.thinking: ההדרכה מציגה את כל סוגי החיסכון וההשקעה, ותחת "מאיפה להתחיל" מופיעות קרן השתלמות, קרן חדשה מקיפה וקרן כספית. יש לי כבר קרן השתלמות, ואני ממשיך לגלול.

Cards under "כסף שוטף וקצר" were cut off, so I only see interest-rate line ends. Of the rest, the study fund with a tax benefit looks best; I'm skipping the pension and child-related options and checking the self-directed one next.

Card titles under "לבחירה עצמית" keep getting cut off mid-scroll, so I'm reading only the line ends. I've found the S&P 500 option, which invests in dollars through a tracking fund, and I'm still checking the MSCI World one.

content.text:
So, short version: the stuff worth checking for my money is a fund that follows the S&P 500, plus the קרן השתלמות I already have, because the page says that after a while you can take money out of it "בפטור ממס". I'm only half sure. The page gave me a list of kinds and nothing more. It has no amounts, no fees and doesn't tell me what to do with 30,000. The thing that decided it was spotting "מדד S&P 500" as one of the things money can go into. My first step would be finding out what my השתלמות invests in.

**How it went:**
- **Top of the page:** "מדריך", "כל סוג של חיסכון והשקעה". Fine, that's what I wanted.
- **"שני חלקים בכל חיסכון":** I read only the first lines. One part is where the money sits (פיקדון, קרן השתלמות, חשבון ניירות ערך), the other is what it's in (מזומן, מק"מ, מדד מניות). I sort of got it: the השתלמות is the box and the S&P is what goes inside. I think so, anyway.
- **"מאיפה להתחיל":** three links. None of them is about having a sum of money and wanting it to grow.
- **"כסף שוטף וקצר":** the scroll cut off the card titles. I only saw "ריבית" at the ends of lines.
- **"חיסכון עם הטבת מס":** קרן השתלמות. I skipped קופת גמל להשקעה, sounds like old-people stuff.
- **Skipped completely:** "פרישה" and "לילדים".
- **"לבחירה עצמית":** the titles got cut off again. I only saw "...קונים, מוכרים ומחזיקים מניות". I didn't scroll back up.
- **"במה הכסף מושקע":** stopped on S&P 500. Glanced at נאסד"ק and the Tel Aviv indices, then the page ended.

**Words I didn't get:** מק"מ, "MSCI World" / "MSCI AC World", "חשיפה לדולר או מנוטרלת ממנו", "מסלול כללי", and the "יומית / מתחדשת" buttons on קרן כספית.

**What bothered me:**
- Not one number anywhere. Nothing on fees, how much things earn, or how much to put in.
- Twice the scroll cut the card titles, so I don't know what two of the sections were.
- Way too many cards that all look the same, and nothing says "this one is for you." If I hadn't seen the S&P I'd have closed it and done nothing today.
- I've never heard of "מקור", so I'd still go check with a bank or a known name.
- The S&P card says "בדולרים" and the others say "בשקלים". Does that mean the S&P is only in dollars? I'm not sure.
